source_read: Cosy Club's own venue menu records (https://content.cosyclub.co.uk/wp-json/wp/v2/menu, the data behind cosyclub.co.uk/menu/<venue>/; field tenkites_menu) and location list (wp/v2/location, 38 venues); the Ten Kites pages they embed: menus.tenkites.com/loungers/cosyclubss26 (10 venues), cosyclubss2602 (14), cosyclubss2604 (8), cosyclubss2605 (3), cosyclubss2606 (1, Oxford, adds a Sunday Roast menu) and staging/cosyclubss2604 (1, Swansea), each with Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Desserts, Kids, Gluten Free, Vegan, Cocktails and Wine menus (Autumn/Winter 2026, menu files named COSYAUTUMNWINTER26-*_2026-10-11); combined sha256 of the saved menus ff745fbd86c9a768609b72210dd5f726f85eb730b4de461b5648573840089c79. Not used: cosyclubaw2503 (Stamford's link), which holds last season's Spring/Summer 2026 menu. robots.txt: cosyclub.co.uk and content.cosyclub.co.uk have none (404); menus.tenkites.com disallows only /fonts/, /views/ and /*.less$.
not_verifiable: the meaning of the asterisk in 'Satay*' (no footnote on the pages; the satay dishes carry no peanut mark, copied as printed)
notes: Second read by other methods than the extractor (which walks the HTML tree with tenkites_c/cosy_club_pages): (1) calories from each page's schema.org JSON-LD block (MenuItem name -> nutrition.calories, parsed with json): all 215 published items found on all 6 used pages, 1,290 comparisons, 0 differences; (2) allergens from the raw HTML of each dish's pop-up with regular expressions (Contains / May contain section values, bracketed kinds ignored): 1,290 comparisons, 0 differences. The extractor itself also cross-checks every dish's printed figure beside its name against its pop-up and table, and the printed allergen lines against the label ids of the page's own allergen filter. Every one of the 6 pages printed every dish with the same calories and allergens (no dish had to be left out for a conflict). Left out: 16 Sunday Roast rows printed only on Oxford's page (1 venue), 450 alcoholic-drink printings (wine menu, cocktails, spritzes, martinis, spirits, Irish Coffee), rows with no figure. Medium audit flags kept as printed: two brioche buns without egg marked, two Caesar salads without fish, the 'Satay*' salmon without peanuts.
